newsitem.title: UK: Mondex takes 10 percent stake in Girovend.
newsitem.headline: Mondex takes 10 percent stake in Girovend.

text.p: Mondex UK, the electronic cash card company jointly owned by National Westminster Bank and Midland Bank, is taking a 10 percent stake in Girovend, the cashless systems business due to float next month.
The move will give Mondex access to Girovend's three million customers, mostly businesses which issue Girovend cards to staff for use in canteens and vending machines.
In a statement Ron Clark, chief executive of Mondex UK said Girovend systems are used for in-house payments by about half of the top 500 listed companies in Britain.
